description.value: Kekuli Cafe is an Indigenous-owned fast-casual restaurant chain founded by Sharon Bond-Hogg, a Nooaitch First Nation member, celebrating First Nations culinary traditions through bannock-based dishes and specialty coffee. The Kamloops location offers gourmet bannockwiches, tipi tacos, Mother Earth Bowls, and a full espresso bar featuring Spirit Bear Organic fair-trade coffee. It's a culturally distinctive stop in downtown Kamloops where cyclists can get a filling meal rooted in Indigenous flavours.
